title: SRD 5.1 importer: Adventuring Gear, Equipment Packs, Container Capacity, and Mounts/Vehicles tables
description:
Complete the D&D SRD 5.1 equipment import by adding the equipment-chapter tables that loreweaver-3n6 intentionally left out of scope. loreweaver-3n6 reconstructed the split-column Armor (13), Weapons (37), and row-major Tools (35) tables, taking the pack from 1 to 85 equipment records, but deferred the remaining tables. These must be present in the final import — they are core player-facing equipment.

Deferred categories (currently NOT emitted):
- Adventuring Gear table (Item/Cost/Weight: backpack, rope, rations, torches, holy water, potions of healing, ammunition, spellbook, etc.) -> kind=equipment, category 'gear'.
- Tools table 'Vehicles (land or water)' row + the separate Mounts and Vehicles section (mounts, tack/harness, drawn vehicles, waterborne vehicles with speed/cost). Decide on category ('vehicle'/'mount' vs 'gear') and what structured fields, if any, to carry.
- Equipment Packs (Burglar's/Diplomat's/Dungeoneer's/etc. with bundled contents + a pack price) -- prose, not a clean table. Decide whether to model as records (e.g. category 'pack' with a contents list) or document as out of scope.
- Container Capacity table (capacity strings, no cost/weight) -- decide whether to attach capacity to the matching gear record or emit/skip.

Why this is hard (the reason 3n6 deferred it): in the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF the Adventuring Gear table extracts as TWO interleaved physical columns whose item NAMES arrive as one bare run (Abacus, Acid (vial), Ammunition, Arrows (20), ...) followed by the cost/weight cells interleaved with the adjacent column's complete rows. Several 'rows' are category headers (Ammunition, Arcane focus, Druidic focus, Holy symbol) with NO cost cell, so the name-run length != the value-run length and there is no naive positional pairing. Mounts/Vehicles is its own section after the equipment endHeading anchor. A faithful, deterministic reconstruction is required; ADR 0007 forbids guessing alignment, and 3n6 added EquipmentColumnMismatchError as the fail-closed pattern for the simple split-column tables.

Reference points in the code: parseEquipment.ts header comment documents the deferral and the gear extraction shape; sections.ts equipment anchor endHeading currently stops before 'Mounts and Vehicles' (a new anchor/region will be needed for that section); README 'Scope today' equipment row lists these as out of scope.
design: Build on the column-block reconstruction and fail-closed guard from loreweaver-3n6 (EquipmentColumnMismatchError). For Adventuring Gear, the name-run and value-run must be reconciled deterministically given the category-header rows that have no value -- likely by anchoring each value cell to its name via the (small, fixed) header structure or by a reviewed name-set baseline rather than blind zipping. Mounts and Vehicles needs a new section anchor/region. Prefer modeling decisions that keep category-specific fields optional and audit-clean (no empty strings; partial-field baseline updated like 3n6 did). If any sub-table genuinely cannot be reconstructed faithfully from the vendored PDF, that specific sub-table may stay documented out of scope with rationale -- but Adventuring Gear (the bulk of player gear) should be imported.
acceptance_criteria:
- Adventuring Gear table rows are imported as kind=equipment records (category 'gear') with verbatim cost/weight and deterministic keys + provenance, OR the specific blocking sub-table is documented out of scope with a concrete extraction rationale.
- Mounts and Vehicles entries are imported or explicitly documented out of scope (with a section anchor added if imported).
- Equipment Packs and Container Capacity are imported or explicitly documented out of scope.
- Reuse/extend the 3n6 fail-closed guard so column-block drift throws rather than emitting partial records.
- Add or extend baseline/coverage tests; update srdGeneratedPack.test.ts counts and partial-field baselines.
- Regenerate the canonical pack; npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack reports no new suspicious findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not change source vendoring policy; do not introduce Pathfinder work.
close_reason: Imported Adventuring Gear (99), Container Capacity (attached), Equipment Packs (7), and Mounts/Vehicles (mounts 8, vehicles 6, tack/drawn gear 13). Equipment 85->218. Reused/extended the 3n6 fail-closed guard (EquipmentColumnMismatchError 'Gear' + new ContainerCapacityError). Pack regenerated; verify/audit/check/typecheck/test all green. PR pending.
